criteriaText: Same name after normalising case, spacing and legal suffix (PT, CV, Tbk).
businessNote: Invoice vendor name must match the Faktur Pajak vendor and the SAP vendor master.

criteriaText: Account number equals the account on file in SAP (LFBK), ignoring spaces and dashes.
businessNote: SAP would still allow posting — the platform must stop it. Vendor master is enough; no payment-history lookup. (Replaces 1.33 “bank account changed since last payment”.)

criteriaText: PO exists and is open in PO master; every document cites the same PO. Single PO per invoice (Q-029).
Case / space insensitive.
Entity code + NPWP match.
Digits only, zero difference.
businessNote: NPWP is only guaranteed on the Faktur Pajak, so the Faktur Pajak is the anchor. No portal check needed.

criteriaText: Seller name on the Faktur Pajak matches the invoice vendor and vendor master.
ISO code.
Map invoice text to the SAP baseline code (DAIM…DZ20).
Invoice unit rate equals the PO net price. When a pack size is shown, the rate applies to quantity × pack size.

runCondition.text: Lines with a quantity and a rate. Lump-sum lines with neither go straight to exception.

businessNote: Example: 240 packs × 25 kg × IDR 14,000 = IDR 84,000,000 (Ecolab). Quantity 1 means the amount is the unit rate.

criteriaText: AI judges the invoice line describes the PO line — any words from the PO description may appear. Treat 60–70% as a match.
businessNote: Vendor and ESSA naming differ (“NALCO 7408” vs “Chemical industrial sodium metabisulfite”). Fewer than 5% of invoices should fall to exception. The GRN check picks the right line when two lines share price and quantity.

criteriaText: WHT code on the PO maps (via the WHT matrix) to the vendor-master WHT setting.
businessNote: The PO is the anchor, not the invoice. Contract marked optional — to be confirmed.

criteriaText: Invoice date equals the Faktur Pajak date.
Faktur Pajak date equals the invoice date. Not checked on the portal.
Invoice quantity equals the received quantity (GRN for goods, SES for services) and is within PO open quantity.
Quantity × unit rate equals the invoice amount and does not exceed the PO open value (0% tolerance).
businessNote: Vendor master does not hold invoice amounts — removed from the vendor master column.

criteriaText: 2 decimals, no tolerance (Q-035).
businessNote: Validated against the invoice only — the portal is not needed for the value.

criteriaText: 2 decimals, no tolerance (Q-035). DPP × PPN rate must equal the Faktur Pajak PPN.
Delay = actual completion or delivery date − baseline date; penalty from the LD matrix.

runCondition.text: Only when the PO has an LD clause. If the PO says “refer to contract”, the contract is read instead.

businessNote: LD must be validated by the AP user before the invoice is parked.

criteriaText: Retention % from the PO is held on every invoice until the defect liability period ends.

runCondition.text: Only when the PO has a retention clause.

criteriaText: Recovery is spread equally across milestones and the invoice shows the deduction.

runCondition.text: Only when the PO has an advance-recovery clause.

businessNote: If the vendor did not deduct it, calculate the amount and raise an exception.

criteriaText: Rate within 1% of the BI middle rate for the posting date (placeholder tolerance).
businessNote: Exchange rate appears on the invoice only, not on the Faktur Pajak.

criteriaText: Due date from the payment-terms matrix, e.g. GRN date + 30 days.
businessNote: Even if the baseline date is not reached, the invoice is processed and sent to SAP. Used for due / overdue reports.

criteriaText: Remaining PO quantity and value after this invoice; reported for long-term POs.
Barcode / QR lookup on Coretax returns the same Faktur Pajak number, vendor name and NPWP.
businessNote: Done manually today by scanning the barcode into the SAP draft invoice. Confirm the portal integration is in the original scope.

criteriaText: Vendor must not carry the negative-list / block indicator in vendor master.
Open debit balance in the vendor ledger (FBL1N) greater than 0 raises an exception.
businessNote: Advances, deposits, or VAT to recover from a negative-list vendor.

criteriaText: Vendor + invoice number + amount + date must not exist among posted invoices.
Faktur Pajak number is not already booked in SAP (also covers 1.16 FP number uniqueness).
Step 1: BAST vs service entry sheet. Step 2: service entry sheet vs invoice. Within 5% or IDR 200,000.

runCondition.text: Only when the PO is progress-billed.

businessNote: “Validation is BAST vs service entry sheet, then service entry sheet vs invoice. If it is within the tolerance we can create the park document.”

criteriaText: Service period ≤ SES date ≤ invoice date, and the Faktur Pajak is within its 3-month validity.
businessNote: Needed to make sure the Faktur Pajak has not expired (valid 3 months from the month issued).

criteriaText: Management / functional approval of the BAST is received (per DOA).
businessNote: BAST is sent through Teams for approval via Avensys; we validate the approvals are received.

criteriaText: Dates on the airway bill and shipping bill match.
Shipper / consignee name matches the invoice and PO.
Guarantee is valid until at least the date the PO requires.

runCondition.text: When the PO requires a guarantee.

businessNote: Bank guarantee is required, not optional — exact match.

criteriaText: Guarantee amount equals the amount the PO requires.

runCondition.text: When the PO requires a guarantee.

criteriaText: BAST must cite the SES used.
UoM synonym table (MD / man-day / HARI).
0% — per category line.
Recompute amount ÷ qty, 0% variance.
Same billing month; OT period within it.
Σ timesheet = summary = invoice qty, 0%.
Zero tolerance (Q-053).
ID exact; name fuzzy as tiebreak.
Mapped to the contract category list.
2% or IDR 100,000, whichever is lower.
Days billed match biometric Face ID attendance.
businessNote: Moved from Common — biometric attendance applies to manpower invoices only.

criteriaText: Persons on board billed equal the meal attendance and Face ID count.
Snack, special-lunch and special-dinner back-charges equal the recap sheet.
Measured quantity within 5% or IDR 200,000 of the BOQ.
businessNote: BOQ applies to civil contracts only — moved from Common.

criteriaText: Construction permit is valid on the invoice date.
Name + travel date + airline + route + amount + VAT resolve one HCIS clearing entry; zero tolerance on amount.
Invoice amount equals the HCIS clearing amount.
